wiki.title: Craig Goldman
wiki.extract: Craig Alan Goldman (born October 3, 1968) is an American politician who is serving as the U.S. representative for Texas's 12th congressional district since 2025. A member of the Republican Party, he previously represented the 97th district in the Texas House of Representatives from 2013 to 2025.
